absoluteRule.containmentRole: existing host containment; not a product or performance SLO
absoluteRule.memoryUnit: host-native memory unit, never pooled or converted
absoluteRule.overContainment: methodology insufficient; do not expand the guard
absoluteRule.overflow: non-passing; exact arithmetic must not wrap, saturate or widen existing numeric record bounds
absoluteRule.qpcConversion: ticks * 1000000000 / frequency as an exact rational before max and margin
absoluteRule.reference: maximum of all ten measured baseline values for the same cell
absoluteRule.rounding: ceil ONCE after exact max and multiplication by the declared ratio

engineeringBasis.role: reviewed engineering rationale only; neither authentic collection evidence nor numeric-table anchor

host.sameClass: before/after each round and across both baselines and heldout per host; no CPU or host-class pooling
host.serviceScope: shared hosted virtual machine; exclusively owned serial measurement session, not exclusive physical host
host.unknownMeaning: explicit unavailable status with reason; never infer unlimited, zero, absent or physically exclusive

rationale.betterBaselineBoundary: at baseline-consistency boundary, up to 21 percent wall and 10.25 percent memory above the better baseline median
rationale.memory: 5 percent worse-baseline native-memory median sensitivity; exact accounting does not establish low variance
rationale.tail: all five heldout samples bounded by worst complete reference tail plus margin, not a blanket median-relative sample limit
rationale.wall: 10 percent worse-baseline median regression sensitivity; scheduling and process startup affect hosted timing

sampling.cache: fresh CLI/runtime process; one warmup; filesystem/tool caches declared warm; no cold-OS or warm-JIT claim
sampling.correctness: preserve paired untimed correctness and cleanup checks; the declaration does not qualify them
sampling.invalid: retain every attempt; fail or invalidate entire session; no automatic retries or outlier deletion
sampling.order: fixed catalogue family/phase/target order; each warmup then five; no concurrent cells

schedule.heldoutPrecondition: actual eligible baseline hashes and derived numeric table authentically and immutably anchored before either heldout job starts
schedule.scope: one prospective performance measurement campaign, not unrelated CI conformance recovery
